dct_creator_sm: Welboren, Anna (Department of Animal Biosciences. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm: This study evaluated the effects of decreasing the omega-6 to omega-3 fatty acid ratio in calf milk replacer by adding omega-3-rich oils (i.e., linseed and algae oil) on gastrointestinal permeability and inflammatory status of preweaning dairy calves.
dct_title_s: Supplemental tables for: Gastrointestinal permeability and inflammatory status of preweaning dairy calves in response to decreasing the omega-6 to omega-3 fatty acid ratio of milk replacer
